objective: Define controlled staging canaries for the active ANA-A07/A09 funnel freshness policy set without granting runtime projection, snapshot publication, scheduler, production, merge or Ready authority.

complete.objective: Prove a fully linked synthetic acquisition-to-order journey produces the eight expected v1 funnel metrics with exact chronology and policy-bound dataThrough.
complete.fixtureStrategy: Create a synthetic service and requested order using staging canary users, normalize the synthetic order metric timestamp into the reserved closed window, insert seven canonical behavior stages, compute, then rollback.
assertions: one valid search impression and one valid click
one strict session+service path through quote_submitted
all eight metric numerators and denominators equal 1 for the isolated window
runtimeAuthority remains false until canary certification is reconciled

orphan.objective: Prove an unpaired search.result_clicked event is counted as an orphan and never promoted into the strict funnel.
orphan.fixtureStrategy: Add one synthetic click with its own search_request_id and no matching impression inside the same isolated complete-path window.
assertions: valid search click numerator remains exactly 1
strict funnel stage counts are unchanged by the orphan

empty-window.objective: Prove transaction-floor watermarks can certify an empty closed window without inventing zero-valued KPI observations.
empty-window.fixtureStrategy: Use a reserved historical window after asserting both canonical source relations contain zero rows in that window.
assertions: every metric value is JSON null rather than numeric zero

late-fact.objective: Prove an ORD projection fact committed after a prior read is excluded while its writer transaction is active and included after commit without violating the active-transaction-floor watermark.
protocol: Create exact-marker synthetic service/order and a complete behavior journey; preserve the canonical order_domain_event but remove only its synthetic order_metric projection before the observation.
Choose a bounded canary window whose end is after the planned writer transaction start.

Schedule one transient pg_cron second-session writer that starts before windowEnd, reinserts the missing synthetic order_metric row with occurred_at bound to the canonical order event, holds the transaction open, then commits.
While the writer is active, prove the transaction-floor watermark equals earliest writer xact_start minus one microsecond and the final funnel numerator remains 0.
After writer commit, recompute the same window and prove the final quote_submitted_to_order_requested numerator changes from 0 to 1 while the denominator remains 1.
Do not write snapshots; A05 append-only revision/backfill semantics remain the authority for any later finalized snapshot correction.
Unschedule the transient cron job and remove all exact-marker synthetic behavior/order/service side effects; verify zero tagged sessions, zero canary rows and zero canary cron jobs remain.

maturity.reason: The active freshness policy is persisted, but complete/orphan/empty-window/late-fact runtime evidence has not yet been executed. Repository contract preparation alone does not promote ANA.
